query:
UPDATE email_backfill_jobs
        SET status = 'Complete',
            initialized_at = COALESCE(initialized_at, now()),
            init_lease_token = NULL,
            init_lease_expires_at = NULL,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
          AND (
              (
                  status = 'Init'
                  AND $2::uuid IS NOT NULL
                  AND init_lease_token = $2
                  AND init_lease_expires_at > now()
              )
              OR (
                  status = 'InProgress'
                  AND $2::uuid IS NULL
              )
          )
